searchText: > So, I have 5 Validators running now for over a month at Medalla. Why is Att. Effectiviness varying between 95% and 40% according to Beaconchain? They are all running within the same Wifi and on the same machine. <@!707707212184944702> anyone? The Goerli incident yesterday was triggered by one validator updating/restarting and another one lagging behind. It was quickly resolvable though. We have to keep in mind that Clique was never intended for production usage. However, if we want to harden networks such as Goerli, I would recommend revisiting EIPs 2181, 2182, and 2183. <@707707212184944702> You should try the discord for the specific client you've been running
